items.title: Steve Allen interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: there’s a recording of Erroll Garner and myself playing [sings] “The One I Love Belongs to Somebody Else.”

ctx.x: Oh yeah. I didn’t even know that was the name of that song. [scats]

Oh really? Yeah. Anyway, so there it is, a jazz album with Art Tatum and myself. If you can play jazz and if you have a great rhythm section, you sound good. You don’t sound as good as Art Tatum, and later I would do that with other people. My favorite pianist of all time, and a dear man too, was Erroll Garner, who couldn’t read a note of music, he was just a genius. At the age of four his genius was recognized. And we could talk about him sometime for six hours, I love every note he ever played. But again,…
Were you able to get a copy?
